text:
tess: hi team — onboarding hit a snag. our GitLab pipeline fails with 403 on the quickstart sample during the first generate call. local laptop works fine.

owen: 403 usually means billing_required for workspace-scoped keys. can you paste the response body (no keys)?

tess: response: `{"error":"billing_required","message":"workspace requires billing before requests are allowed"}`

ravi: did you create the key from your user profile or from the workspace? user-scoped keys sometimes allow a few demo calls, which explains local success.

tess: i created it from the user console and uploaded to GitLab as SECRET. thought that would be fine.

onboard-bot: :robot_face: heads up — personal keys may work interactively but CI should use service keys pinned to a workspace. Service keys require the workspace to have billing enabled. See console docs.

owen: also check if the sample sets REDWOOD_WORKSPACE in the container image or in config defaults. we've seen cases where a baked-in workspace id points to an unbilled sandbox.

tess: good call. the quickstart Dockerfile had ENV REDWOOD_WORKSPACE=workspace-demo. i missed that.

ravi: options: 1) remove baked REDWOOD_WORKSPACE so the key's workspace is used, 2) set REDWOOD_WORKSPACE in CI to a billed workspace, or 3) add billing to the demo workspace.

tess: removed the default env and re-ran -> still 403. debug step shows header `X-Redwood-Workspace: workspace-demo` coming from config file inside the image.

owen: grep for that header in repo. sometimes sample app's client sets it explicitly.

tess: found it in config/default.json and fixed. pipeline now returns 200 and logs show first successful call recorded. :tada:

ravi: follow-ups: add a short troubleshooting section in quickstart README explaining 403 vs 401, include a CI check snippet: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/account | jq .billing.enabled`, and avoid baking workspace defaults in sample images.

onboard-bot: pro tip: include a `scripts/ci-healthcheck.sh` in templates that prints helpful failure reasons (missing key, workspace mismatch, billing).

tess: will open a tiny PR to update README and add the healthcheck. thanks for the quick help!
